title: Unit Test Stub (symbol)
summary: Uses generate-test to produce a unit-test skeleton for one qualified symbol
intro: Read this when a routine has no test yet: generate-test produces a unit-test skeleton for one qualified symbol, in DUnitX or DUnit style.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Generate & Export > Unit Test Stub (symbol)...
steps: Put the caret on the routine in the editor
Choose drag-lint > Generate & Export > Unit Test Stub (symbol)...
A unit-test skeleton for the symbol is generated
From a shell: `drag-lint generate-test --qname <Foo.TBar.Baz> [--framework dunitx|dunit] [--db PATH]`

questions.ask: How do I get a test skeleton for one routine?
